cases.sentence: На восемнадцатом году правления Еровоама, сына Навата, Авия стал царем ___.
cases.translation: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijam became king of Judah
cases.explain: The phrase 'king of Judah' uses the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Его мать звали Мааха, она была внучкой ___.
cases.translation: His mother's name was Maacah, and she was the granddaughter of Abishalom
cases.explain: In the phrase 'granddaughter of Abishalom', the name takes genitive case.

cases.sentence: Давид делал то, что было правильным в глазах Господа и во все дни жизни не отступал от его ___.
cases.translation: David did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn away from his commandments all the days of his life
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Асса делал то, что было правильным в глазах Господа, как и его предок ___.
cases.translation: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his ancestor David had done
cases.explain: The noun is used in comparison and takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он изгнал из страны мужчин-блудников и убрал всех идолов, которых сделали его ___.
cases.translation: He drove out the sodomites from the land and removed all the idols that his forefathers had made
cases.explain: The possessive relationship uses genitive case.

cases.sentence: Асса срубил ее столб и сжег его в долине ___.
cases.translation: Asa cut down her Asherah image and burned it in the Valley of Kidron
cases.explain: The preposition в with the instrumental case indicates location.

cases.sentence: Между Ассой и Баашей, царем Израиля, во все дни их правления шла ___.
cases.translation: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days
cases.explain: The noun война (war) is the subject of the impersonal verb, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он внес в Господень ___ серебро, золото и различную утварь.
cases.translation: He brought into the house of the Lord silver, gold, and various items
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with direction uses accusative case.

reading.ru: Авия стал царем Иудеи. Он правил в Иерусалиме три года. Его мать звали Мааха, она была внучкой Ависалома.
reading.question: Who was Abijam's mother and what was her lineage?
reading.explain: The text identifies his mother as Maacah and states she was the daughter of Abishalom.

reading.ru: Асса делал то, что было правильным в глазах Господа, как и его предок Давид.
reading.question: How was Asa's righteousness compared to other rulers?
options: He did what was right like his ancestor David
He was more righteous than David
He was less righteous than David
He was not righteous at all
reading.correct: He did what was right like his ancestor David
reading.explain: The text says Asa did right like his ancestor David.

reading.ru: Он даже лишил Моаху, свою бабушку, положение царицы-матери, за то, что она сделала отвратительный столб Ашеры.
reading.question: Why did Asa remove his grandmother from her position as queen mother?
options: Because she had made an idol to Asherah
Because she helped the prophets of Baal
reading.correct: Because she had made an idol to Asherah
reading.explain: Asa removed her because she had made an abominable Asherah pole.

reading.ru: Он не упразднил святилищ на возвышенностях, но сердце его было все же полностью предано Господу во все дни его жизни.
reading.question: What did Asa fail to do, yet his heart remained devoted to God?
options: He did not remove the high places, but his heart was still fully devoted to God
He did not defeat all his enemies
He did not build the temple
He did not marry a righteous woman
reading.correct: He did not remove the high places, but his heart was still fully devoted to God
reading.explain: The text shows Asa's incomplete reform but affirms his devoted heart.

reading.ru: Тогда Асса взял все серебро и золото, которое оставалось в сокровищницах дома Господа, и его собственного дворца.
reading.question: Where did Asa get the treasure he sent to Ben Hadad?
options: From the treasuries of God's house and his own palace
reading.correct: From the treasuries of God's house and his own palace
reading.explain: The text explicitly states he took treasure from both God's house and his own palace.

reading.ru: В старости он страдал от болезни ног. Асса упокоился со своими предками и был похоронен с ними в городе своего предка Давида.
reading.question: How did Asa's life end?
options: He suffered from a foot disease and was buried in David's city
reading.correct: He suffered from a foot disease and was buried in David's city
reading.explain: The text mentions his illness and describes his burial in David's city.
